deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO: 2 open trades, both LONG, +0.03 USDT unrealized. BTC LONG (ai-trader-manual, just opened) and SOPH LONG (bb-bounce-v2-long+, +0.54%). Both regime-aligned with the micro-uptrend. No action needed on either — SOPH is halfway to TP at 0.00245, BTC is flat at entry.

MARKET: BTC at 82380, above EMA300 for 40+ consecutive 1m candles, linreg BULL on all timeframes, zscore STRONG_POS. 4h regime LONG_BIAS. BUT volume is LOW and velocity is SLOW — this is a grind, not a rip. The 5m regime scanner shows mixed signals: 19 LONG_BIAS vs 23 SHORT_BIAS across 125 tokens, overall SHORT_BIAS on the short timeframe. The market is chopping with a slight upward drift on BTC. Low-vol grind favors mean-reversion entries (bb-bounce) over trend-following breakouts.

CRITICAL PATTERN — SHORT SIDE IS BROKEN: Last 24h: LONGs 55% WR (+0.84 USDT) vs SHORTs 23% WR (-0.71 USDT). The system is net shorting into oversold zones and getting bounces. 9 pump-chain- SHORT losses in 24h, ALL entered at meta_rsi 42-56 — the neutral/oversold band where bounces are most likely. The WINNING side on those trades was LONG: every coin that stopped us out went UP. We were on the wrong side. The trend is up (BTC above EMA300, 4h LONG_BIAS). Shorting alts during a BTC uptrend = fighting the tape.

bb-bounce-v2-long is also underperforming: 51.9% WR, -0.22 net over 27 trades. The losses (APT, ALT, ETC, BABY) all entered at meta_rsi 50-56 — mid-range, not extreme oversold. A bounce signal works at RSI extremes, not mid-range chop. The winners were at lower RSI levels.

AI TRADER PICK: SOL LONG. RSI 51.3 (center of band), LONG_BIAS regime conf 55.4, +0.92% over 16 5m-candles, ATR 0.83%. Precheck PASS all gates. RR 1.28 grade C is mediocre but passes. BTC above EMA300 supports longs. No SOL trades in 7 days — clean slate.
regime_context: BTC micro-uptrend: above EMA300 for 40+ min, linreg BULL across 1m/5m/15m, zscore STRONG_POS. But volume LOW and velocity SLOW — this is a low-participation grind, not a confirmed trend. 4h regime LONG_BIAS (conf ~55), 15m SHORT_BIAS (conf ~79) — timeframes disagree. The 5m scanner shows overall SHORT_BIAS across alts (23 SHORT vs 19 LONG), but BTC itself is LONG_BIAS. Mixed regime = chop. The correct posture: favor LONGs on BTC-correlated majors (SOL, AVAX, SUI), avoid counter-trend SHORTs on alts that are already oversold. Wyckoff ACCUMULATION phase on BTC supports a slow grind higher. Watch for volume expansion — if volume picks up with price up, the trend confirms. If volume stays flat, this is range-bound chop and mean-reversion is the only edge.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERN 1 — pump-chain- SHORTs lose to bounces (n=9 losses in 24h, all meta_rsi 42-56):
FIL (-2.3%, rsi 42.2), DOT (-3.7%, rsi 43.5), BIGTIME (-0.1%, rsi 44.4), INJ (-3.2%, rsi 52.9), GRASS (-0.7%, rsi 43.6), CRV (-2.1%, rsi 48.2), IO (-2.4%, rsi 48.5), DOT again (-2.0%, rsi 55.6), APT (-2.9%, rsi 47.3).
WINNING SIDE: LONG. Every one of these coins bounced after our short entry. The meta_rsi at entry (42-56) is the neutral-oversold zone — shorting here = catching a falling knife in reverse. The pump-chain- signal fires when zscore is deeply negative (oversold), but oversold in an uptrend = bounce setup, not breakdown setup. WHY WE WEREN'T ON THE RIGHT SIDE: The signal's zscore trigger fires on any dump, regardless of higher-timeframe trend. BTC is above EMA300 (uptrend), so alt dumps are pullbacks, not trend reversals. Shorts should only fire when BTC is BELOW EMA300 (confirmed downtrend). FIX: pump-chain- should check BTC ema300_position before firing SHORT. This is a signal-level fix for the brain auditor, not a watchdog action.

VERIFIED PATTERN 2 — bb-bounce-v2-long losses at mid-range RSI (n=4 losses in 24h, all meta_rsi 50-56):
APT (-4.1%, rsi 53.7), ALT (-2.9%, rsi 55.6), ETC (-1.7%, rsi 50.0), BABY (-4.0%, rsi 55.6).
WINNING SIDE: These coins kept drifting DOWN after our long entry. At RSI 50-56, there's no oversold pressure to bounce from — the signal is firing on a mid-range pullback that continues. A bounce LONG needs RSI < 45 to have room to revert to the mean. WHY WE WEREN'T ON THE RIGHT SIDE: The bb-bounce-v2 trigger fires on price touching the lower Bollinger Band, but in a low-vol grind the lower band is close to price — touching it doesn't mean oversold. The signal needs an RSI floor (ideally < 45) to avoid firing in no-man's-land. Note: BB bounces at RSI < 45 did win (DOGE rsi 43.8 +2.5%, XPL rsi 49.2 +3.9%). FIX: add RSI < 50 filter to bb-bounce-v2-long — brain auditor scope.

VERIFIED PATTERN 3 — SHORT side is net negative, LONG side is net positive (24h):
LONG: 33 trades, 18 wins (55% WR), +0.84 USDT. SHORT: 13 trades, 3 wins (23% WR), -0.71 USDT.
The SHORT trades that won (POL volume-buildup- +0.8%, ENS volume-buildup- +2.7%) had meta_rsi 38-60 — the ENS short at rsi 60 worked because it was shorting overbought. The SHORT losses were all at rsi 42-56 — shorting neutral/oversold. The pattern: SHORT only works when shorting overbought (rsi > 55), never when shorting oversold (rsi < 50). pump-chain- fires on oversold zscore, which is exactly when SHORT fails.
